name: speak with plants
lore:
### On the Communion of Verdure: Speak with Plants

To the uninitiated, the forest is a silent sentinel; to the master of this arcana, it is a deafening parliament. When weaving the threads of this spell, the Arcanist feels the Weave thicken, turning heavy with the scent of crushed mint and damp loam. It is a slow, rhythmic thrumming—not the sharp crackle of evocation, but the ancient, turgid heartbeat of the earth itself.

As the incantation peaks, a verdant luminescence spills from the caster’s fingertips, settling like glowing emerald dew upon the foliage. The plants do not possess mouths of flesh; instead, their fibers realign, creating a resonant, rustling vibration that translates intent directly into the mind.

Legend attributes this discovery to the **Silent Gardener of Elmsworth**. Faced with a kingdom-wide blight, he spent forty days with his ear pressed to a single parched stalk of wheat. On the forty-first morning, the grain finally whispered its thirst. He did not merely save the harvest; he proved that even the lowliest briar remembers the touch of the first sun. Tread softly, traveler, for the grass has much to say of your passing.
